nodes.summary: Fisher's average effect of allele `a`: `α a = ∑_b p_b g(a, b) - μ`.
nodes.title: Fisher's average effect of an allele at a single locus

nodes.summary: Cockerham–Kempthorne variance components up to order `n`: `V i j = V_{A^i D^j}` is the component of `i` additive and `j` dominance factors (`V 1 0 = V_A`, `V 0 1 = V_D`, `V 2 0 = V_AA`, …). They are nonnegative, there is no `(0, 0)` component, and the genetic covariance of relatives with `2φ` and `Δ` is `∑_{i, j ≤ n} (2φ)^i Δ^j V i j`. This structure is the stated representation; it is proved for one locus by…
nodes.title: Cockerham–Kempthorne variance components

nodes.summary: The genetic covariance of relatives with coefficients `2φ = twoPhi` and `Δ = Δ`.
nodes.title: Genetic covariance of relatives in Cockerham form

nodes.summary: The dominance deviation `δ a b = g(a, b) - μ - α a - α b`.
nodes.title: Dominance deviation at a single locus

nodes.summary: With monozygotic twins (`k₂ = 1`), dizygotic twins (`k = (1/4, 1/2, 1/4)`) and a common environment `C`, `2 (Cov_MZ - Cov_DZ) = V_A + (3/2) V_D`.
nodes.title: One-locus phantom heritability, unconditional

nodes.summary: Equality holds iff every non-additive component of order `≤ n` vanishes.
nodes.title: Equality case of the phantom heritability inequality

nodes.summary: Falconer's estimator is `V_A` plus the non-additive components weighted by `2 (1 - 2^{-i} 4^{-j})` (derived from Cockerham's coefficients).
nodes.title: Falconer's estimator in terms of Cockerham components

nodes.summary: Falconer's estimator under the ACE model, in covariance form: monozygotic twins have `2φ = Δ = 1`, dizygotic twins (full sibs) `2φ = 1/2`, `Δ = 1/4`, and both share the same common-environment covariance `C`; the estimator is `2 (Cov_MZ - Cov_DZ)`.
nodes.title: Falconer's estimator

nodes.summary: A single locus under random union of gametes: allele frequencies `p` on a finite allele set and symmetric genotypic values `g a b` (the mean phenotype of genotype `{a, b}`).
nodes.title: Single-locus model under random union of gametes

nodes.summary: The population mean genotypic value `μ = ∑ p_a p_b g(a, b)`.
nodes.title: Population mean genotypic value at a single locus

nodes.summary: Phantom heritability on the correlation scale (Zuk et al. 2012): with phenotypic variance `V_P > 0`, the narrow-sense heritability `V_A / V_P` is at most the ACE estimate `2 (r_MZ - r_DZ)`, where `r = Cov / V_P`.
nodes.title: Phantom heritability

nodes.summary: The one-locus covariance between relatives is the Cockerham form of `toComponents`.
nodes.title: Single-locus covariance between relatives in Cockerham form

nodes.summary: Covariance between relatives at one locus (Fisher 1918; in the IBD form of Falconer and Mackay ch. 9): for IBD probabilities summing to one, `E[G_X G_Y] - μ² = (k₁ / 2 + k₂) V_A + k₂ V_D`, i.e. `2φ V_A + Δ V_D` with kinship `φ = k₁ / 4 + k₂ / 2` and `Δ = k₂`.
nodes.title: Covariance between relatives

nodes.summary: The mean product of genotypic values of two non-inbred relatives that share `0`, `1`, `2` alleles identical by descent with probabilities `k₀, k₁, k₂`: given the IBD state, the non-shared alleles are independent draws from `p`.
nodes.title: Mean product of genotypic values of two relatives

nodes.summary: Average effects are centred: `∑ p_a α_a = 0`.
nodes.title: Average effects are centred

nodes.summary: Dominance deviations are orthogonal to every allele: `∑_b p_b δ_{ab} = 0`.
nodes.title: Dominance deviations are orthogonal to every allele

nodes.summary: The one-locus model as Cockerham components of order `1`: `V 1 0 = V_A`, `V 0 1 = V_D`, `V 1 1 = 0`.
nodes.title: Single-locus model as Cockerham components

nodes.summary: The additive variance `V_A = V 1 0` (zero if `n = 0`).
nodes.title: Additive variance of the Cockerham components

nodes.summary: The phantom-heritability inequality in covariance form: `V_A ≤ 2 (Cov_MZ - Cov_DZ)`.
nodes.title: Phantom heritability inequality

nodes.summary: The additive variance is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the single-locus additive variance

nodes.summary: The additive variance `V_A = 2 ∑ p_a α_a²`.
nodes.title: Additive variance at a single locus

nodes.summary: The additive fit is least squares (Fisher definition of average effects): every additive fit `c + h a + h b` has mean squared error at least `V_D`, the error of `μ + α a + α b`.
nodes.title: The additive fit is least squares

nodes.summary: The dominance variance is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the single-locus dominance variance

nodes.summary: The dominance variance `V_D = ∑ p_a p_b δ_{ab}²`.
nodes.title: Dominance variance at a single locus

nodes.summary: Fisher decomposition of the genetic variance: `V_G = V_A + V_D`.
nodes.title: Fisher decomposition

nodes.summary: The genetic variance `V_G = ∑ p_a p_b (g(a, b) - μ)²`.
nodes.title: Genetic variance at a single locus

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
